title: Itihasa: A large-scale corpus for Sanskrit to English translation
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset for Sanskrit-to-English translation using verses from the Ramayana and Mahabharata. While the content of these epics is religious/spiritual, the paper focuses exclusively on the computational and linguistic task of machine translation and benchmarks models using standard metrics like BLEU and TER, rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
